en: A vintage postcard showing a large gun labeled "110 TON GUN" mounted on a concrete base on a grassy hilltop. In the foreground, a few people sit on benches behind a small fence, overlooking rolling green countryside with a winding road and a village in the distance. The image is printed in color, with extensive handwritten text covering the sky and margins. Near the top of the image, printed in red, is the title indicating the location near Brighton.
